concept.title: Verifying authentication and permissions
concept.shortdesc: To verify authentication and permissions for Red Hat Quay repository mirroring and resolve mirroring issues, you can ensure credentials have the necessary access on source and destination instances.

conbody.p: On the Red Hat Quay UI, check the following settings:

ul.li: The access control settings. Ensure that the user or service account performing the mirroring operation has the required privileges.
The permissions of your robot account on the Red Hat Quay registry.
